critical_code_review_comments: catalog_router.py L458-461: path-traversal guard uses `str(safe_path).startswith(str(COURSE_RESOURCES_DIR.resolve()) + '/')` — correct, but note that a filename containing '/' will resolve to a subdir outside; a URL-encoded traversal ('..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd') decodes into a path segment for FastAPI's `{filename}` — verified behaves correctly (returns 400 or 404). Consider also rejecting any filename containing `/` early with `if '/' in filename: raise HTTPException(400)` for defence-in-depth.
catalog_router.py L462: resource missing on disk returns 404 with generic message — fine, but logging the mismatch (resource in DB but file absent) would help ops.
CourseDetail.jsx ResourceRow uses `createObjectURL` blob approach — works reliably in Playwright expect_download() as verified. No changes needed.
